findings.evidence: The checker-result jq gate accepts `.schema == "nomos.gate_k.checker_result@1" and (has("protocolRevision") | not)` unconditionally, and the packet-manifest jq at lines 378-381 likewise accepts @1 regardless of the revision-6 path; unlike the task-receipt pairing (rev-6 branch requires task_receipt@2), no generation pairing is checked for checker_result or packet_manifest. Demonstrated with the offline harness: a checker record whose artifacts/checker.json was relabeled to `nomos.gate_k.checker_result@1` (protocolRevision removed) with all digests rebound passed `gate-k-eval-finalize.sh` and produced `result.json` verdict `pass` with `checker_receipt@2`/`protocolRevision: 6` embedding the @1 checker result (embedded `.result.schema == "nomos.gate_k.checker_result@1"`, `.result.protocolRevision` absent). COLD_AGENT_PROTOCOL.md states revision-6 checker results use strict @2 generations and carry protocolRevision 6, and no adversarial test covers this stale-generation mix (only adjudication staleness is tested).
findings.summary: Revision-6 finalization does not enforce the strict revision-6 @2 generation for checker results or packet manifests; a stale @1 checker result is accepted inside a revision-6 composite and finalized as a passing revision-6 result.

findings.evidence: The finalizer validates rev-6 receipts with `.operatorRetries >= 0` (line 138) and `validate_v2` only requires independence_integrity = fail when retries differ from 0, so a retried run finalizes as `fail` (preserved evidence). Demonstrated with the offline harness: a checker record with `operatorRetries: 1` (independence_integrity set to fail, overall verdict fail) finalized successfully, and the emitted RUN.md contained `- Operator retries: `0` for subject and checker` while `task-receipt.json` reported `operatorRetries: 1`.
findings.summary: The generated RUN.md hardcodes `Operator retries: 0` regardless of the recorded receipts, so any revision-6 run finalized with a recorded retry carries a false statement in its evidence record.
